contact.faqTitle: Your questions answered about Agrofil fertilizers and support
contact.faq1Q: What types of fertilizers does Agrofil produce?
contact.faq1A: Agrofil produces granular, water-soluble and liquid plant nutrients, including drip NPK, chemical, organic, orgamineral, microelement, straight and nitrogen fertilizers.
contact.faq2A: Our office is at Fevziçakmak Mah. 10762. Sok. A1-Blok No: 12C Karatay / Konya, Turkey.
contact.faq3Q: How can I contact the export team?
contact.faq3A: For export inquiries, email export@agrofil.com.tr or call +90 552 634 44 43.
contact.faq4Q: What product groups do you offer?
contact.faq4A: We offer drip (NPK), chemical, organic, orgamineral, microelements, straight and nitrogen fertilizer groups.
contact.faq5A: Yes. Our organic fertilizer range includes products such as King Root, Fil Seaweed, Rapid Growth, Power Humi+K and more.
contact.faq6Q: What are drip (NPK) fertilizers used for?
contact.faq6A: Drip NPK fertilizers deliver precise plant nourishment through fertigation for healthy and sustainable crops.
contact.faq7A: Monday to Friday, 8:00–18:00. Saturday and Sunday are out of office, but you can call or email any day.
contact.faq8Q: How do I get product details or a catalog?
contact.faq8A: Browse our product groups online or contact us for catalog details and product information.
